prompt: As of 2024, what percentage of Afroasiatic language speakers speak Central Atlas Tamazight?
answer:
As of 2024, Central Atlas Tamazight had about **2.7 million speakers**. Against an estimated **roughly 500 million Afroasiatic-language speakers worldwide**, this represents:

\[
\frac{2.7\text{ million}}{500\text{ million}}\times100 \approx 0.54\%
\]

So, **approximately 0.5% of Afroasiatic language speakers speak Central Atlas Tamazight**. Because both figures are estimates—especially the total for Afroasiatic languages—the precise percentage may vary slightly.
